title: Agent Execution Integrity Benchmark (AEIB) & Sovereign Multi-Agent OS (SMAOS) Open Core Protocol Specification v1.0
description:
AEIB (Agent Execution Integrity Benchmark) is a bounded research prototype for a versioned transport-to-disposition mapping contract in structured research-agent workflows. It maps transport observations (such as HTTP 504 Gateway Timeouts, TCP resets, or dropped sockets)—combined with available probe evidence—to explicit dispositions and retry policies, emitting Ed25519-signed, JCS-canonicalized (RFC 8785) evidence receipts for offline verification.

Key Repository Artifacts:
1. Versioned Contract: docs/transport-to-disposition-mapping.yaml (15 wire fault vectors)
2. Offline Verifier: Standalone Python receipt verifier (aeib_verify.py) executing with zero external network egress.
3. Execution Governor & Latch: Software state-machine safeguards implementing retry suppression and quarantine state latching.
4. Research Workflow Middleware: src/research_mcp_adapter.py (Figshare dataset staging & Dimensions query execution).
5. Replication Harness: replication/reproduce_all.py (41 clean-room test cases).

Explicit Scope Statement:
AEIB builds on existing work in execution finality, action-evidence boundaries, consume-once settlement, execution receipts, and transactional outboxes; it does not claim novelty for those underlying primitives. Claims are strictly limited to the implemented test environments and declared simulation model.
